nodes.name: Receive Input
nodes.notes: Formal input contract for this sub-workflow: workflow_run_id + research_data (the array produced by 'Arya OS - Research'). Can also be run manually for standalone testing — n8n allows pinning sample input data on this node.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Script Agent (Future FastAPI)
nodes.notes: TODO: BACKEND ENDPOINT MISSING — 'POST /api/agents/script' does not exist in the FastAPI backend today (verified routes: /approvals, /feature-flags, /lineage, /health*). Do not invent this route on the backend just to unblock this node; build it deliberately when ScriptAgent (backend/app/agents/script.py, currently a NotImplementedError stub) is wired up. Host fixed to host.docker.internal for local dev (n8n container -> host FastAPI process). Credential now references the shared 'arya_backend_shared_secret' httpHeaderAuth credential — create it once in n8n and every backend-calling node in this suite reuses the same one. retryOnFail added (3 tries, 2s apart) for transient network errors; continueOnFail stays on since a missing endpoint must not crash the whole pipeline (routes to the Validation-Failed branch instead).

httpHeaderAuth.name: Arya OS Backend - Shared Secret (create once, reuse everywhere)

nodes.name: Validate Response
nodes.notes: Checks the placeholder HTTP call didn't error AND returned a non-empty script_content field. No content-quality/AI validation happens here — that's Script Validation's job downstream. This is purely 'did the HTTP call return something usable at all.'

nodes.name: Set - Validation Failed (Placeholder)

nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER failure path — since /api/agents/script doesn't exist yet, every real run currently lands here. Returns a null-content script_json with an error field so downstream nodes/Human Approval can detect the failure instead of silently getting empty data. FIXED: now also preserves workflow_run_id (was missing).

nodes.name: Return script_json

assignments.name: script_json
assignments.value: ={{ { workflow_run_id: $('Receive Input').item.json.workflow_run_id, script_id: $json.script_id ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_SCRIPT_ID', script_content: $json.script_content, word_count: $json.word_count ?? null, model_used: $json.model_used ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_MODEL' } }}

nodes.notes: Final output contract for this sub-workflow: a single top-level 'script_json' object, consumed by the Main Orchestrator's Execute Workflow node. FIXED: now also preserves workflow_run_id (was missing).

meta.notes: Sprint 1-3 scaffold sub-workflow. Input contract: workflow_run_id + research_data. The HTTP Request node calls a FastAPI route ('/api/agents/script') that does not exist yet — the current backend only has /approvals, /feature-flags, /lineage, and /health*. No AI/LLM logic lives in this workflow itself; ScriptAgent (backend/app/agents/script.py) is still a NotImplementedError stub. Output contract: a single top-level 'script_json' object, intended to be called via Execute Workflow from 'Arya OS - Main Orchestrator'.
